rule: per compute unit: an arm fails if it produces inf or NaN (in any output, intermediates included) at a stress level where C4 stays finite on the same unit; real inputs (x1) must always be finite. ANE-layout arms (<arm>-ane: 1x1 conv2d on (1, C, 1, T)) are compared with C4-ane

inputs.x1: layer activation of the probe clip (1x clip RMS)

outputs: C7: raw (matmul before the row scale), out; C8: P, N, raw = P - N, out; others: out. Exposing intermediates as outputs may change the compiled graph. Non-finite maxima are written as the strings inf/nan (strict JSON).
accumulation: backend-defined (not exposed by Core ML); recorded as such
